notes: Eight web searches ran; none was refused. Representative-elect, so no House record; he could not have sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act and none was found. Campaign site (mcgowanforiowa.com home and /vision pages) has no AI content; /vision mentions 'standing up to China, bringing jobs back to America'. Debate quotes come from the transcript on the PBS video page, read through a page-fetch tool that returned excerpts; the reviewer should confirm the exact wording against the video or captions. The fetch tool summarized him as opposing a slowdown of AI because of China and as mentioning foreign-made goods with 'malware, listening devices, spyware'; those were not confirmed verbatim in a second read and are left out.
